status: Planning data extracted from the screenplay. No voices have been recorded and nothing has been rendered.
rules: Only text following a named speaker or NARRATOR is spoken (screenplay instructions).
'text' holds only the spoken words: no surrounding quotes, no bracketed notes, no [ORIGINAL] marker.
Lines with original=true are the creator's own words and must be performed and subtitled byte-exact.
Bracketed notes and 'delivery' are performance guidance; never speak or subtitle them.
Dragons have no human dialogue; they communicate by posture, breath, growls, calls and eye movement.
An em dash at the end of 'text' means the line is cut off (interrupted=true). A leading em dash means it picks up a cut-off line ('continues' names that line).
Every line other than the four originals is proposed adaptation dialogue, not recovered creator dialogue.
Subtitles come from the final recorded dialogue; re-run this script if the screenplay changes.

fields.speaker: role name exactly as the screenplay cue
fields.addressee: who the line is spoken to, only when the screenplay states or clearly shows it; else null
fields.addressee_source: bracket = '[to X]' note; named in line = vocative/title in the line; stage direction = action text says so; context = the surrounding exchange makes it explicit
fields.delivery: bracketed performance note (if any) followed by brief context from the stage directions
fields.performance_note: the bracketed note alone, minus ORIGINAL and 'to X'
fields.bracket_raw: the bracket exactly as written in the cue
fields.is_command: true for dragon commands (Attack/Fire/Hold/Skit/Free fire) and rider-to-dragon directional speech
fields.interrupted: true when the line ends in an em dash
fields.continues: id of the cut-off line this one resumes, else null
fields.subtitle_cues: suggested subtitle cues; '\n' separates the two rows of one cue
fields.subtitle_min_seconds: minimum on-screen time for reading the whole line (see subtitle_model)
fields.beat_after: a silent beat that must follow the line (not spoken, not subtitled), else null
fields.source_line: 1-based line number of the quoted text in screenplay.md

timing_model.summary: Estimates for planning and animatic timing only. Real recordings replace them.
timing_model.words: count of letter/digit tokens; contractions count as one word ("don't" = 1)
timing_model.conversational: seconds = words / 2.6 + 0.25 x internal sentence breaks
timing_model.slow: if performance_note is whispered, quietly, low or through pain: seconds = words / 2.1 + 0.25 x breaks
timing_model.narrator: seconds = words / 2.1 + 0.40 x breaks (clear, restrained, sparse)
timing_model.one_word_commands: fixed: 0.8 s normal/firm/shouted; 1.0 s low or quiet authority (Queen Fall); 0.6 s cut off mid-word
timing_model.multi_word_directional: use the conversational rule (e.g. 'Home. Come on.')
timing_model.internal_sentence_break: a . ? or ! followed by more words inside the same line
timing_model.floor: every line is at least 0.6 s
timing_model.excludes: pauses between lines, reactions, breaths, silences such as Abby's after L046

subtitle_model.splitting: one cue if the line fits in two rows with any row break on punctuation (or the line is a single sentence); otherwise pack whole sentences into cues, then comma clauses, then split at a word boundary, preferring before 'when/and/but/who'. Rows break at the most balanced space, preferring sentence ends, then commas; never after 'the/to/and', never before 'me/him/them/us'.
subtitle_model.subtitle_min_seconds: max(1.0, characters / 17), rounded up to 0.1 s; show the cue at least this long even if the speech is shorter
subtitle_model.text_rule: subtitle text is exactly 'text'; never add [ORIGINAL], bracket notes or speaker names

lines.speaker: KING OF CLING
lines.delivery: quietly — Almost to himself, recognizing her.

lines.speaker: GUARD CAPTAIN
lines.delivery: Unsure.

lines.speaker: KING OF CLING
lines.delivery: Practical under pressure; final. The captain does not ask again.

lines.speaker: GUARD CAPTAIN
lines.text: Through the arch! Keep the center clear! Move now!
lines.delivery: Shouted orders to the crowd.
subtitle_cues:
Through the arch!
Keep the center clear! Move now!

lines.speaker: QUEEN FALL
lines.delivery: High above, riding Starlight. Low-key authority, no shouting. Attack means the physical dive; no flame.

lines.speaker: GUARD CAPTAIN
lines.delivery: Shouted, reaching for the king.

lines.speaker: KING OF CLING
lines.text: Open both sides! Don't let them crowd the arch!
lines.delivery: Shouted while pulling toward his people, not toward the private exit.
subtitle_cues:
Open both sides!
Don't let them crowd the arch!

lines.speaker: KING OF CLING
lines.delivery: Shouted as fragments fly past the stone support.

lines.speaker: PARENT
lines.delivery: Urgent, reaching the arch with the child.

lines.speaker: CHILD
lines.delivery: Frightened, in the dust.

lines.speaker: PARENT
lines.delivery: Steady and protective. Not a dragon command.

lines.speaker: GUARD
lines.delivery: Reaching the king.

lines.speaker: KING OF CLING
lines.delivery: Refusing to go first.

lines.speaker: GUARD
lines.delivery: Looking up; the warning is true.

lines.speaker: VENDOR
lines.delivery: Crawling clear of the wrecked stall.

lines.speaker: ADULT VILLAGER
lines.delivery: Injured, conscious, frightened; the king cuts in.

lines.speaker: KING OF CLING
lines.text: Tell the guard where they were. He'll look.
lines.delivery: Practical; no empty promise that everyone is safe.
subtitle_cues:
Tell the guard where they were.
He'll look.

lines.speaker: GUARD
lines.delivery: The acknowledgement the king waits for.

lines.speaker: KING OF CLING
lines.text: Find the injured. Bring them under stone cover. Keep someone watching the sky.
lines.delivery: Dust on his clothes. Quiet working orders, not a speech.
subtitle_cues:
Find the injured.
Bring them under stone cover.

lines.speaker: GUARD CAPTAIN
lines.delivery: Subdued.

lines.speaker: KING OF CLING
lines.text: And send word to King Fallen.
lines.delivery: King Fallen of Scrapper, a different person from Queen Fall.
subtitle_cues: And send word to King Fallen.

lines.speaker: GUARD CAPTAIN
lines.delivery: Looking toward the receding white shape.

lines.speaker: KING OF CLING
lines.text: Starlight attacked Cling. Tell him exactly what you saw.
lines.delivery: The last spoken line of the episode. Plain and heavy.
subtitle_cues:
Starlight attacked Cling.
Tell him exactly what you saw.
